decision_basis: Project owner approval on 2026-11-10 after 20+ public sources were audited with zero quantitative registrations under the single full-replay standard.
claim_scope: Reproduction of CERES-Maize response structure on observations that were not used for coefficient calibration. This is not field validation of the MARS training environment (UFGA weather, IBMZ910014 soil).
independence_wording: SIAZ and BRPI are separate years at the calibration site: report as independent-year evaluation, not independent-site evaluation.

A_undamaged_water_response.evidence_level: treatment-mean dry grain yield replay with calibration and evaluation years separated in the published source

criterion.source: Jamieson, Porter and Wilson (1991) Field Crops Research 27:337-350, https://doi.org/10.1016/0378-4290(91)90040-3
criterion.timing_note: The 1995 yields had been viewed on 2026-11-09 before this standard was adopted. The thresholds are the literature convention and were not tuned on these yields. Do not describe this judgment as preregistered.

fixed_inputs.coefficient_basis: Ma et al. 1996 PEST coefficients, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eja.2020.126017
fixed_inputs.selection_rule: Inputs follow the published calibration and the field record. Yield error is never used to choose between input variants.

open_input_caveats: distributed weather file coordinates differ from the published field location
80 cm representative soil profile versus gravel layer starting at 0.8-1.7 m in the field
replicate-plot yields and variances are not public
DSSAT 4.8.0.024 replay of coefficients calibrated in DSSAT 4.6

secondary_not_judged.use: report yield RMSE as the interval 399.0-854.5 kg/ha across distributed weather and station June solar radiation; the weather lineage is unresolved so no pass/fail is assigned

B_damage_recovery_relative_yield.evidence_level: relative yield ratio (damaged / undamaged control) by damage stage and intensity against published treatment means
B_damage_recovery_relative_yield.rationale: The ratio cancels most site-specific soil, weather and cultivar inputs, so complete replay inputs are not required.
B_damage_recovery_relative_yield.primary_source: purdue_indiana_defoliation_2024_2025 (CPN-4016 Table 2): treatments defined as percent defoliation at V8, V13 and R1, which maps directly onto the model's uniform leaf removal fraction

items.water_nitrogen_damage_interaction: Seven public sources were screened and zero eligible replicated field designs exist.
items.calibrated_new_damage_survey: No public data links new leaf loss within the same 7-day window to independent repeated ratings.

C_not_field_verifiable.disposition: Removed from the pre-training gates. Carried as stated limitations and sensitivity analyses. Survey noise and temperature thresholds remain explicit assumptions.
C_not_field_verifiable.h3_scope: H3 is analysed only within the range that passes tier B, otherwise reported as exploratory with no confirmatory claim.

parked_candidates.ransom_lewis_2015: no CERES coefficients or ecotype can be fixed before opening yields
parked_candidates.ransom_shumway_2016: no CERES coefficients or ecotype can be fixed before opening yields

unresolved_weakness: Becker 2016 showed a smaller split-N response than observed. The tiers do not resolve this nitrogen-response weakness.
